criteria.text: Diagnosis of Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome (LEMS) (approval criterion 2).
Patient is 6 years of age or older; shared age floor for both products (approval criterion 1; see product-specific age notes).
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist or neuromuscular specialist (approval criterion 3).
Patient does not have a history of seizures (approval criterion 4).
Prescriber agrees to monitor for use with acetylcholinesterase inhibitors or other medication that can lower seizure threshold (approval criterion 5).
Patient has moderate to severe weakness that interferes with daily functions (approval criterion 6).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Firdapse® / Ruzurgi® (amifampridine), potassium channel blockers for Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome (LEMS). Version 2; Original 10/3/2019; Approval 11/18/2022; Effective 1/2/2023.

Encoded: approval criteria 1–6 with a shared age floor of 6 years. Failure to meet approval criteria is a denial. Specialist consultation, seizure history, medication monitoring agreement, and functional weakness require documentation verification.

Product-specific age nuance (notes only): Ruzurgi requires age ≥6 and <17 years. Firdapse approval criteria allow age ≥6, although the FDA indications section of this PDF describes Firdapse as adult-only. The shared age predicate does not enforce the Ruzurgi upper bound; product-specific eligibility requires manual review.

Cautions (notes only): can cause paresthesia/dysesthesia, abdominal pain, dyspepsia, dizziness, and nausea. Consider discontinuation or dose reduction for patients who have a seizure during treatment. Concomitant drugs that lower seizure threshold may increase seizure risk; drugs with cholinergic effects can increase adverse reactions.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization up to 12 months if responding positively based on clinical muscle strength AND no seizures.
Quantity (notes only): Ruzurgi 10 tablets/day, maximum 100 mg/day; Firdapse 8 tablets/day, maximum 80 mg/day. max_units is null; dosing and quantity are not evaluated.

Documentation verification, product-specific age eligibility, cautions, ongoing monitoring, duration, reauthorization response, dosing, and quantity enforcement require manual review; this pack remains partial.
